method.mode: in-process paired alternating trace disabled/enabled after one warmup
method.baseline: The same implementation with AGENTPLANE_TRACE disabled.
method.candidate: The same implementation with AGENTPLANE_TRACE=1 and trace output captured in memory.
scenarios: task next-action --explain with complete work-order preparation
method.functional_comparison: Exact stdout equality for every paired run.
method.scope_note: RF-26a instruments and selects candidates; it does not enable preparation caches.

threshold.reason: Tracing is opt-in diagnostics; a 15 percent median ceiling bounds its observer cost without constraining normal execution.

expensive_nodes.note: Inclusive of live fingerprint preparation and intentionally non-cacheable.

cache_candidate_selection.reason: Largest local structured input and highest local standalone latency.
cache_candidate_selection.eligibility: conditional on a cheaper HEAD/index/worktree invalidation probe than rebuilding the snapshot
conditional on task revision and backend projection being available before assembly

cache_candidate_selection.policy: exact task revision and backend projection
cache_candidate_selection.reason: Repeated structured read with explicit provenance.
cache_candidate_selection.eligibility: conditional on a backend-specific revision or file-stat probe

semantic_boundary.rule: Semantic or authority decisions remain non-cacheable unless a later contract supplies complete provenance, invalidation, and mandatory live revalidation.

staleness_validation.method: Focused recorder tests repeat unchanged observations and mutate task revision, Git HEAD, and provider PR state independently.
staleness_validation.expected: Only the changed node reports its named fingerprint input as invalidated.

evidence.benchmark.verdict: Instrumentation overhead is bounded and functional output is unchanged; cache speedup is deferred to RF-26b.
